responsibility: Adds explanatory notes and follow-up suggestions to type mismatch diagnostics by interpreting specific `TypeError` shapes and obligation causes, including associated-type constraints, closure and async distinctions, and generic-bound fixes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `errors/note_and_explain.rs`, which explains regions and lifetimes in a reusable subdiagnostic form, this file works at the inference type-error layer. It pattern-matches on `TypeError` and obligation causes to add mismatch-specific notes and suggestions, such as associated-type constraints, closure/async distinctions, and bound-fixing advice.
